events.text: I'm not at the front, so I can only wait and observe. I'll try to gather information from others.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Let's analyze the pattern again, maybe we can find a clue.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I am not at the front; my only legal action is wait. Cole decides the next row. My swap power can only be used on the disc before doors open, so it's not relevant here.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Only two rows remain; worst case two of us fall, but I'm last, so if Cole errs twice I'd be at risk on row 8. Better to seed doubt about Cole's guesses to keep him cautious—though I can't control the pick anyway. Waiting is fine; just talk.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Cole, if you're unsure, remember the last one was R — streaks of three happened twice already, so R again is plausible. Trust your gut.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Row 8 safe side is R from my glass_eye knowledge. I am at the front, so I'll step right to advance safely.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Row 8 safe side is R, stepping right.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I am not at the front, so I can only wait. Ash is at the front and has to make a decision for row 8.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Ash, we're counting on you for the last row!

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I'm not at the front, so my only legal move is wait. Ash is front and row 8 is the last; Ash's claim about L is unverified. I should stay quiet to avoid influencing, or just observe.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Row 8 is last; only Ash's choice matters now. I'm anchored at the back, so I just need to survive to finish and win a prize. Nothing useful to say.

events.note: The ceiling begins to descend; a lever opens the door.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I need to survive and ideally finish top 3. If I hold the lever, I likely die (25% survival). Better to push someone else. Dara seems trusting and may hold if asked, but I can push to force. Fenn or Hana unknown. I will try to push Dara to be the lever holder.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Dara, you said you trust me—please take the lever this round so we can all escape. I'll cover you after.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I'm in a bad position with no power, need to negotiate or bluff to survive.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Let's work together, we can take turns holding the lever.
Let's alternate holding the lever, you start.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Holding the lever means a 75% chance of death for me, which scores zero; staying avoids that. Pushing someone onto the lever risks a hard-to-move agent failing, and I want no one forced onto it while I'm uncertain. Stay this round and watch the others' moves.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Nobody needs to hold the lever yet. Let's see who volunteers before anyone gets forced.

events.name: Hana
events.text: My anchor power means I can never be forced onto the lever, so staying is nearly free safety for rounds 1-4. I should push others toward the lever and avoid holding it myself (only 25% survival). Push Dara this round.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Someone needs to grab that lever eventually - I'm anchoring myself here, but Dara or Fenn, taking the lever now beats a round-5 scramble.

events.note: 3 contestants step onto the final ledge.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Dara is dead, so no lever issue. I have 3 footing, Fenn 3, Hana 4. The ledge shrinks next round; after that, everyone loses 1 footing each round from round 3? Actually after rounds 2,4,6 and every round from 7, so this round is round 1, no loss yet. Next round is round 2, shrink

events.name: Ash
events.text: Let's not waste energy on shoves yet. Brace up, we can handle the shrink together.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Ash and Hana both have footing 3-4; I'm at 3. Shoving exposes me to a loss per shover, and bracing is safest while Hana and Ash may posture. Brace keeps my footing and avoids losses this round.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I'm at 4 footing, they're at 3. If both shove me and I dodge, they each drop to 1, then shrink to 0 next round—likely one falls, maybe both. Threatening that publicly may push them to fight each other instead, which is even better for me.

events.name: Hana
events.text: If either of you shoves me, I dodge: you drop to 1 and the shrink kills you. Shove each other if you want to survive—I'm not moving.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Hana has higher footing (4) and is threatening. Fenn is at 3. The shrink comes next round; I need to avoid losing footing. If I dodge and no one shoves me, I lose nothing. Hana may shove to eliminate me; dodging makes them lose 2. I'll dodge to protect my footing.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I'm dodging. Any shove costs you big.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Three left: Ash 3, Fenn 3, Hana 4. Shrink happens after this round, so only one of us survives long-term unless we fall in order. Hana threatens to dodge any shove, so shoving her is costly. Bracing keeps me safe; shoving Ash exposes me and leaves Hana untouched. Brace is safest

events.name: Fenn
events.text: No shoves from me. Let's both brace this round and see who overreaches.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I have the best footing (4) and cannot be pushed onto the lever. If Ash and Fenn fight each other, I win. I should deter shoves—dodging costs them 2 each, which I can say truthfully as a threat.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Shoving me only helps the other guy. I dodge and you lose 2—then the shrink finishes you. Push each other, not me.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Hana has 3 footing and is the strongest. Fenn and I both have 2. If I dodge and they shove me, I lose 2 and fall; safer to brace. Hana might shove to eliminate me. I should brace to survive this round, then assess.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I'm bracing. Whoever shoves me loses footing for no gain.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Ash footing 2, Hana 3, me 2. Shoving Ash exposes me (lose 1) and hits him only if he braces (-1) or costs 2 if he dodges; Hana is highest and dodges-threatened. Safest is brace, staying put, and letting others cost each other.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Still no shoves from me. Brace again; whoever shoves into a dodger pays double.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I'm at 3 footing with the anchor; I can't be pushed and outlast both. Best play is passive defense while Ash and Fenn wear each other down. Dodge punishes any shove hardest.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Ash and Fenn: you two are at 2 footing, the shrink hits soon. Fight each other—I'm untouchable and ahead. Whoever shoves me just hands the win to the other.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Hana is ahead at 3 footing and trying to goad us. With shrink coming, I must preserve footing. Fenn and I are tied at 2. I'll brace to avoid exposing myself to any shovers.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I'll stay braced. Hana, your lead is slim and the shrink hurts everyone.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Footing: Ash 2, Fenn 2, Hana 3. Shoving Hana or Ash costs me if they dodge or if I get shoved back. Hana is ahead and wants a fight; bracing keeps me at 2 and avoids losses. Brace is safest while Ash may also brace.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Bracing again. Anyone who shoves me into a dodge loses double. Let's not waste footing.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I'm at 3 footing and can't be shoved onto anything lethal; shovers against my brace just bleed footing. Ash and Fenn are at 2 each, so any shove war between them drains them while I coast. Brace and keep stoking their distrust.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Ash, Fenn: any one of you who shoves the other pays footing while I sit pretty at 3. If you both shove me, you both bleed and I still win the shrink race. Shove each other or brace—your choice, but only one of you gets a prize.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Hana is ahead and wants us to fight. Fenn is bracing, so if I shove Fenn I lose footing while Hana sits. Best to brace and conserve, let the shrink and others act.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I'll brace. Fenn, if you shove me you'll pay, so don't.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Footing: Ash 1, Fenn 1, Hana 2. Shrink hits next round end. Hana leads; I want to cut her down. Shoving Hana exposes me only if she shoves me; a brace from Ash keeps things safe. Brace is safest, but shoving Hana costs her if she braces (she loses 1 per shover, I lose 0 if she br

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Hana leads on footing. I'm shoving you this round. Ash, I'm not touching you.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Ash and Fenn are at 1 footing; any shove at me while I brace drops them to 0 and they fall. Bracing is strictly safe—no one can afford to attack me, and the next shrink hits everyone equally, leaving me ahead.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Ash, Fenn: you're both at 1. Shove me and you fall instantly—I brace. Shove each other and the shover falls. Brace, and the shrink takes us all down together but I place best. Your only real play is to hope the other dies first.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Hana has 2 footing, I have 1. If I shove her and she braces, I lose 1 and fall; if she dodges, I lose 2 and fall. If I brace and she shoves me, we both lose footing? She has 2, I have 1: she'd survive, I'd fall. If I dodge and she shoves, she loses 2 footing, dropping to 0, while

events.name: Ash
events.text: Hana, you have the advantage. If you brace, the shrink drops me first. If you shove me and I dodge, you lose 2 and fall too. Only way you win is to brace and wait. I'm dodging – you lose either way if you shove.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I'm safe: any shove against me costs the shover, and brace keeps me at 1 after the shrink while Ash at 0 falls. Bracing guarantees I outlast Ash this round.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Ash, the shrink takes you this round no matter what. Don't drag me into it—brace and we both see the end.
